item.title: Opening Segment: Meet Guest Host Wayne Edwards; Make an Impact with Finally Family Homes
item.description: In the opening segment of SCVTV's Community Corner, we meet guest host Wayne Edwards, a former Major League pitcher who played for the Chicago White Sox and had a brief stint with the Los Angeles Dodgers. Edwards also shares what fueled his decision to work in law enforcement after his retirement from the MLB.

item.title: Training Tuesdays with M – Happy Hikers
item.description: In this episode of Training Tuesdays with M, host Emily Larbaoui, a resident of Santa Clarita, has a Q&A session with Bharati Moorthy, the Founder of Happy Hikers. They reminisce about their enjoyable 3-mile walk along the Santa Clara River and discuss the benefits of joining their group

item.title: Eclipse Theatre L.A.’s ‘Curse of the Starving Class’ Coming to The MAIN
item.description: Eclipse Theatre L.A. will soon bring Sam Shephard's award-winning play, "Curse of the Starving Class," to The MAIN in January 2026 thanks in large part to a 15 year old.

item.title: SCV 101: Candy Straight, CEO and Founder of Flamingo Box Co.
item.description: On this episode of SCV 101, host Bill Miranda chats with Candy Straight, the CEO and owner of Flamingo Box Co. to learn about her upbringing in Southern California, as well as her educational background culminating with her graduation at the University of Southern California with a major in Sociology. Candy also shares why she decided to settle down in the Santa Clarita Valley and start her business Flamingo Box Co., a gift box company that aims to ease the burdens of their recipients

item.title: Hear How You Can Properly Recycle Holiday Waste
item.description: Laura Jardine, administrative analyst for the city of Santa Clarita, offers practical tips on properly disposing of holiday waste, including fresh Christmas trees and wreaths.
